summary.intent: Add Phase 36 to the roadmap for refactoring upload progress from a popup modal to inline display in the file browser, then gather implementation context via discussion.
summary.outcome: Phase 36 created with a shortened slug (36-inline-upload-progress), feature branch renamed to feat/phase-36-inline-upload-progress, CONTEXT.md written with locked decisions on placement/detail/lifecycle/cancel-error UX, and all changes committed.

repo: gsd-tools has no built-in 'phase rename' subcommand — renaming requires manual directory rename, ROADMAP.md edits, and file reference updates
Phase slugs are auto-generated verbatim from the description argument, with no length cap — long descriptions produce unusably long directory names
Upload progress is currently handled by UploadModal.tsx and UploadItem.tsx as a floating popup widget
The project uses a terminal aesthetic UI, Zustand for state management, and an SDK upload pipeline (encrypt → IPFS → register)
A pending todo exists to offload large file encryption to a Web Worker — distinct from progress display concerns

code.finding: Decisions locked: inline row at alphabetical position, thin progress bar under filename (no percentage), green flash ~1s on complete then swap to normal row, per-file cancel ([✕]) with immediate row removal, inline error state with retry [↻] and dismiss [✕]
Phase 36 entry uses slug 36-inline-upload-progress after manual rename from the verbose auto-generated slug

workflow: When passing long descriptions to /gsd:add-phase, manually shorten the slug afterward — the tool will generate a slug matching the full description
Branch naming convention is feat/phase-{N}-{short-slug}; renaming requires git branch -m and re-tracking upstream if already pushed
discuss-phase workflow respects a discuss_mode config — 'discuss' triggers interactive gray-area selection, 'assumptions' triggers automated codebase analysis

friction: Auto-generated slug from the full description was absurdly long, requiring a manual multi-step rename (directory, ROADMAP.md, internal file references, git branch)
No gsd-tools rename command meant the fix required 5+ separate manual edits across files
open_items: Web Worker encryption offload (existing todo, score 0.9) — explicitly deferred, not part of Phase 36
Phase 36 is not yet planned — next step is /gsd:plan-phase 36 (optionally with /gsd:ui-phase 36 first for UI design contract)
